description: NSW Foundation Spatial Data Framework - Transport - Rail Associated Facilities is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Customer Service. Various facilities associated with the Railway dataset. The following is a ‘facility point’ being a point feature class defining a facility related to transport. Railway Station: a structure beside a railway line with facilities for passengers and freight. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Customer Service. Its tags are Geospatial, NSW Spatial Data Framework, Spatial Services, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
